lines.text: Paul, a servant of God and apostle of Jesus Christ, writes to Titus, his true child in the faith.
Paul left Titus in Cyprus to set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town.
An elder must be blameless, the husband of one wife, and hold firmly to the faithful word as taught.
Rebellious people full of empty talk must be silenced, because they undermine entire households for the sake of revenge.
Paul tells Titus to rebuke them sternly so they will be sound in the faith and ignore Jewish myths.
